state: accepted at original neutral D1 boundary with explicit platform/coordination limits

exact_contract.title: Implement guarded migration apply and recovery
exact_contract.goal: Apply a validated migration on Linux, macOS and Windows with retained before-state, explicitly scoped coordinated concurrency guarantees and truthful interrupted-state recovery.
steps: Implement explicit apply for .C plans: verify input/target epoch and exact source bytes/digest under the declared participating-client barrier, retain before-images and durable intent, then publish through portable safe filesystem/journal primitives. Do not claim unconditional content-CAS against uncooperating writers.
Support a real recognized legacy authored-format transition without guessing new source classification/feature intent; validate the resulting reader-visible format.
Inject interruption before/after each write and provide inspect/recover/idempotent replay; record completed/pending/unknown effects instead of assuming Err means no write.
positive_cases: A known legacy document migrates preserving comments, values and selected intent.
Repeated exact apply is idempotent; supported interrupted recovery restores/completes the owned prefix.
Linux, macOS and Windows each have a usable implementation under the declared contract; missing unrestricted CAS alone does not disable Linux.
negative_cases: Observed concurrent source change, unknown third state or ambiguous input refuses; document unexcluded external races and report actual guarantee, warning and effect state rather than claiming unrestricted CAS.
A failed migration cannot silently lose source, rewrite fixtures/upstreams or fabricate successful rollback.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.
acceptance: Runnable fixtures cover real before→after reader behavior, preservation and recovery.
Generated report/errors retain exact source/target/effect state across process exit.
Product documentation and generated reports distinguish coordinated guarantees, external-writer limits and measured native-platform proof; all three platforms have working implementation paths.
exact_contract.safe_stop: Migration apply/recovery foundation passes; source/feature converters remain their own atoms.
exact_contract.commit_subject: feat(migrate): apply exact format transitions with recovery
notes: Do not make this early foundation depend on completed M-16 editing services. Preserve an explicit adapter seam; M-16 later adds participating-buffer barriers to these same domain operations.

Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

Owner ruling 2026-09-29 accepts weaker platform concurrency guarantees where necessary, requires Linux/macOS/Windows usability and truthful documentation/warnings. See campaigns/next/owner-rulings/2026-09-29-portable-migration.md. This supersedes the unrestricted exact-CAS assumption without waiving preservation, durable recovery or owned-path authority.

Bounded surface registration amendment: the four additional CLI owners are only for the early migration machine entry and explicit MCP server migration-store/file grants. Reuse existing generic dispatcher channels. Follow PROP-044#MANIFEST-MIGRATION-SURFACES; do not modify unrelated command, lifecycle, configuration or package-manager behavior.

portable_ruling.interpretation: working platform implementation paths required; tested Linux evidence explicitly separate from later native macOS/Windows proof; no hostile CAS requirement

limits: Same designated physical project/store participating clients only
Process-exit cuts are not power-loss/every-syscall proof
Cross-restart target recognition uses exact byte/mode, not persistent per-object identity; closed warning preserves this limit
No source/feature/Redbook recipe integration or M16 editor barrier claimed
review_corrections: Transactional-owned reuse needs held prepublication stage receipt and actual sync
Readonly Unix stage must not require write access solely for sync
Owned bounded allocations require checked/fallible capacity, no new arbitrary quota
Independent P2: keep live receipt through final domain observation; actual RED/GREEN, backend integration correction
